protocol.globfire_algorithm: 2026 product from MCD64A1 C6.1 burned pixels; final event perimeters, initial/final dates; event merging by ST-DBSCAN; minimum four pixels (~86ha).
protocol.purpose: Retrospective spatial-temporal coincidence audit of active-fire detections, not ignition prediction.

events.nearest_region: Cerro Ventana - Hueco de la Ventana

limitations: GlobFire is satellite-derived and is not independent ground truth.
Only the GlobFire 2024 layer was used in this cohort; no extrapolation to other years is supported.
The route cohort is fixed sample centers, not complete trail geometries.
A coincidence measures detection of active fire, not advance warning or ignition prediction.
A handful of events cannot support a reliable precision estimate.
